root_cause_analysis: Fact summaries for allowed vs dismissed appeals under identical statutory sections (e.g. Section 138 NI Act or Section 302 IPC) share high textual overlap.
Judicial outcome determination in appellate courts depends on evidentiary evaluations and judicial discretion that are not present in pre-trial fact text alone.
Excluding the final 3,000 characters (disposition section) prevents target outcome leakage, preserving valid machine-learning methodology.
